data: Which conversation has the highest naive distance at 40% conversation segment/

The question asks which conversation type has the highest naive distance at 40% conversation segment. From the caption, we know that the orange line represents risk-assessed conversations, while the black line represents non-risk-assessed conversations. The leftmost graph shows the mean naive distance for both conversation types across different segments. At 40%, the orange line (risk-assessed) is above the black line (non-risk-assessed), indicating a higher naive distance for risk-assessed conversations at this point. Therefore, the risk-assessed conversation has the highest naive distance at 40% conversation segment.
